description: Ministry of Justice - Order to authorize the incorporation of the Trustees of the "School for the Hearing Impaired Trust" namely Mrs. Ranjethamalar Balasingham, Mr. Ajitkumar Charies, Mrs. Dhushyanthy Lewis, Mr. Seenithamby John Thevathas, Mr. Sinnathurai Varathaseelan and Mrs. Mary Matida Christy
reasoning: This gazette notification is an Order made under Section 114 of the Trusts Ordinance (Chapter 87), authorizing the incorporation of trustees. It establishes a legal framework for the "School for the Hearing Impaired Trust" as a body corporate, defining its legal powers and capacities. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments, legal incorporation, and regulatory authorization under existing legislation.
